author: Team Lead
text: We need to refactor the authentication module. Current implementation has security vulnerabilities.

author: Senior Developer
text: I agree. We should implement OAuth 2.0 and add rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks.

author: Junior Developer
text: OAuth 2.0 seems overkill for our use case. Can we just strengthen password policies?

author: Security Officer
text: Password policies alone won't be sufficient. We need multi-factor authentication as well.

author: Team Lead
text: Let's create a task list and assign it to the security team. They'll review all options.

author: DevOps Engineer
text: The CI/CD pipeline is failing on the latest commit. Docker image build is timing out.

author: Senior Developer
text: Have you checked the Docker file? We might have too many layers or large dependencies.

author: DevOps Engineer
text: Just optimized it by removing unnecessary dependencies. Build time reduced from 15min to 3min.

author: Team Lead
text: Great work! Can you document the optimization steps for future reference?

author: QA Tester
text: Found critical bugs in the payment module. Transaction processing is failing for certain credit card types.

author: Backend Developer
text: Which card types? We need to test with the payment gateway's sandbox environment.

author: QA Tester
text: American Express and Discover cards are failing. Visa and Mastercard work fine.

author: Backend Developer
text: I see the issue. We need to update the gateway configuration to support additional card types.
